tolerance_rule.statement: usable iff the harmonic-sum peak clears the best RIVAL comb (its own small-rational family excluded always, and on a multi-rotor rig the +-6 % neighbourhood of the candidate too, since those candidates are the rig's other rotors) by >= 3 dB AND the two disjoint halves of the window agree to <= 1 rev/s AND the stationary window is >= 8 s
